title: Cut 7: meaning roles, on feature/meaning-roles
situation: 0028 listed the meaning roles for realization; since then the catalog re-cut and the reconstitution cut realized the architect and illustrator as agents, decision rights and the operator in their profiles, illustration in practice, and 0086 retired the separate meaning-holder. Two things remain: the architect's replies, whose values 0106 moved here because no guard can hold a reply shown as it is written, and the freeze of concepts, which the design states and no tooling enforces.
decision: One cut on feature branch feature/meaning-roles, across workflow and agents, both held by the architect. (1) The architect's own text holds what its replies must: bottom-line-up-front ordering (0078, 0100, 0117), no menu in place of a recommendation, no hand-back of a decision it owns, and an owned decision recorded before it is reported; held by text and checked by the examples moved here, never by a guard that judges replies (0106); the parked reply guards are not brought back. (2) Freeze of concepts: while a cut is built, the journal refuses a supersession or retirement of a concept that cut realizes from anyone but the architect, checked before the entry is appended. The context map's contracts become a cut of their own after this one (0118).
consequences: The examples in the cut-7 files carry over; the illustrator revises them for 0117 and writes the freeze examples cold. Held-out agents 4 was burned and is visible; a cold held-out share is written for this cut.
